messages.subject: Feature request: Percent identity cutoff
messages.body_plain:

Thanks so much!

Cheers,
Yang

messages.subject: Chromosome name character limit?
messages.body_plain:
Hi - I have many samples mapped to chromosomes with names greater than 99 characters. Is there a way to make featureCounts work with longer names? Maybe a compilation setting?

Thanks!
messages.body_snippet:

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: Chromosome name character limit?
messages.body_plain:
You can change the setting in subread.h:

#define MAX_CHROMOSOME_NAME_LEN 100

to the value for your data, and then re-compile the package. It is not suggested to change the value larger than 200, though.

When feature is relatively small (eg. tRNA fragments or other RNA fragments) and there are significant amount of reads overlaping the feature while being much longer than featrure (eg  tRNA fragment (a feature) full-length tRNA (reads)). Then all longer reads will be counted also giving false results.

For example, if i set --read2pos 3, does it determine the 3'-most base position for mates 1 and 2 by looking up their POS and CIGAR fields?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: reciprocal overlap of reads and genomic feature
messages.subject_clean: reciprocal overlap of reads and genomic feature
messages.body_plain:
Sorry for my delayed response and thank you for your suggestion.

We will implement a new parameter called '−−fracOverlapFeature' to allow the control of how much bases in the feature should overlap with the read. Combined with the '−−fracOverlap' option, you will be able to control the required percentage of overlap for both reads and features.

However, I am not sure how this is going to help you with the scenario you described (tRNA fragments and full length tRNA)?

Wei

Wei
